ModMetaData.name: Modern Expand Menu
ModMetaData.author: yintx, deepseek
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Material Design 3 style grouped right-click menu[/h1] [i]MD3 风格的分组右键菜单[/i]
[b]What it does[/b] When you select a colonist and right-click a single-cell storage container holding multiple items, instead of the vanilla flat float menu, this mod shows a modern MD3-style floating window. Items are grouped by type — each group header shows the item icon, name and total count, with actions (wear, pick up, haul, force wear) listed as an expandable submenu underneath. The window follows the mouse, supports scrolling, and is capped at a maximum height. [i]选中小人后右键一个存放了多种物品的单格储物容器时，本模组会弹出一个 MD3（Material Design 3）风格的现代化悬浮窗来取代原版扁平菜单。物品按类型分组展示，每个分组的标题显示物品图标、名称与总数，下方以子菜单形式展开各类操作（穿戴、拾取、搬运、强制穿戴等）。悬浮窗跟随鼠标弹出，支持滚动，并设有最大高度限制。[/i]
[b]Actions per item[/b] - Apparel: Force wear / Pick up / Haul to storage - Other haulable items: Pick up / Haul to storage [i]衣物：强制穿戴 / 拾取 / 搬运到储物区；其他可搬运物品：拾取 / 搬运到储物区。[/i]
[b]Requirement[/b] RimWorld 1.6
[b]Extras[/b] - Fully customizable: animation speeds, menu max height, 16-hex colors with 6 palettes (menu palette & misc palette are separate) - Settings organized in two categories (Expansion Menu / Misc) with independent preview windows - Optional global MD3 styling (default off): vanilla buttons / checkboxes / tabs / scrollbars / input fields / sliders - Optional MD3 for vanilla UIs (default off): window borders, command buttons, menu sections & list rows, schedule bar, inspect pane (also fixes status bar overlap), statistics grouped cards, ideology menu (culture rows & meme cards) - Misc: skip upload countdown, spacebar pauses only (never unpauses), reset-to-defaults with diff dialog, config export/import/manager, 3 languages (EN/SC/TC) [i]全面可自定义：动画速度、菜单最大高度、16 进制颜色 + 6 套调色板（扩展菜单配色与杂项配色各自独立）；设置分两大类（扩展菜单/其他）并带独立预览窗口；可选全局 MD3 样式（原版按钮/复选框/tab/滚动条/输入框/滑块）；可选原版界面 MD3 化（窗口边框、命令按钮、菜单区块列表行、管制栏、信息卡（并修复状态栏重叠）、统计分组卡片、文化菜单）；杂项：跳过上传倒计时、空格仅暂停、恢复默认（差异勾选）、配置导出/导入/管理、三语言。[/i]
[b]Notes[/b] The mod takes over when right-clicking 2+ item types (ThingCategory.Item) and groups them; right-clicking colonists etc. keeps the vanilla menu. [i]右键命中 2 种及以上物品类型时接管并分组；右键殖民者等非物品目标保持原版菜单。[/i]
